papers.title: Search Improves Label for Active Learning
papers.abstract: We investigate active learning with access to two distinct oracles: Label (which is standard) and Search (which is not). The Search oracle models the situation where a human searches a database to seed or counterexample an existing solution. Search is stronger than Label while being natural to implement in many situations. We show that an algorithm using both oracles can provide exponentially large problem-dependent improvements over Label alone.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于主动学习与搜索ORACLE，与有限元代理模型或生物力学设计无直接或间接联系。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is about active learning with a search oracle in pure machine learning; it does not address FEA surrogate modeling, expensive simulation sampling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 改进主动学习效率，引入更强的搜索ORACLE。
summary_zh.method: 提出同时使用标注ORACLE和搜索ORACLE的主动学习算法。
summary_zh.result: 理论上证明了搜索ORACLE能带来指数级的问题相关改进。
summary_zh.validation: 纯理论分析，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance active learning by leveraging a query-efficient search oracle alongside a standard label oracle.
summary_en.method: Proposes an active learning algorithm that combines label and search oracles, where the search oracle returns a seed or counterexample from a database.
summary_en.result: Shows theoretically that the search oracle can provide exponentially large problem-dependent improvements over label-only active learning.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical analysis only; no empirical validation is provided.

papers.title: Submodular Learning and Covering with Response-Dependent Costs
papers.abstract: We consider interactive learning and covering problems, in a setting where actions may incur different costs, depending on the response to the action. We propose a natural greedy algorithm for response-dependent costs. We bound the approximation factor of this greedy algorithm in active learning settings as well as in the general setting. We show that a different property of the cost function controls the approximation factor in each of these scenarios. We further show that in both settings, the approximation factor of this greedy algorithm is near-optimal among all greedy algorithms. Experiments demonstrate the advantages of the proposed algorithm in the response-dependent cost setting.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究具有响应依赖代价的子模学习和覆盖问题，与FEA代理建模方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA, surrogate modelling, uncertainty quantification, or any computational mechanics or biomedical design contexts.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究在交互式学习中动作代价依赖于响应的情况，提出自然贪心算法。
summary_zh.method: 提出贪心算法并分析其在主动学习和一般场景中的近似因子。
summary_zh.result: 证明贪心算法的近似因子由代价函数的不同性质控制，且近于最优。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验展示算法在响应依赖代价设定下的优势。

summary_en.motivation: This work addresses interactive learning and covering problems where actions incur different costs depending on the response, aiming to design efficient algorithms.
summary_en.method: A natural greedy algorithm is proposed, and its approximation factor is bounded in both active learning and general settings using different cost function properties.
summary_en.result: The greedy algorithm achieves near-optimal approximation factors among all greedy algorithms, as demonstrated theoretically and empirically.
summary_en.validation: Experiments on synthetic and real-world learning tasks validate the advantages of the proposed algorithm in response-dependent cost scenarios.
